entry.title: Cooper Flagg DOES IT ALL with 34 PTS, 8 AST, 5 STL & 4 BLK | November 27, 2026
entry.content:
Cooper Flagg delivered a historic performance against the Phoenix Suns, finishing with 34 points, 7 rebounds, 8 assists, 5 steals, and 4 blocks in a thrilling 113-109 Dallas Mavericks comeback victory. The Mavericks overcame a 21-point deficit to secure their fourth consecutive NBA Cup win, clinch home-court advantage in the quarterfinals, and improve to 12-7 overall.
